EmailTemplate.description: Send your transcripts to Admission Services at ASU
EmailTemplate.name: INTL Mailing Address for Transcripts
EmailTemplate.subject: Send your transcripts to Admission Services at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Arizona State University. Please mail official transcripts or certified copies of your last three years of high school to Admission Services, as well as any university course work you have completed.
If the date of your graduation is not clearly listed on your transcripts, please enclose a copy of your graduation diploma.
TOEFL, IELTS, SAT or ACT scores must be sent directly from the testing agency electronically or by mail.
We will not accept emailed or faxed copies of transcripts or academic documents.
Mail academic documents to: Admission Services Arizona State University PO Box 870112 Tempe, AZ 85287-0112 If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
